summary: Resume a paused Readable and permit flowing consumption, including discard when no consumer observes data.

target.notes: Switch explicitly paused streams to flowing mode, return the same stream, and consume/discard data if no data listener/pipe observes it; has no effect while a 'readable' listener governs consumption.

semantics.no_data_listener: data can be consumed and discarded

caveats: Calling resume() without a consumer is observable because data may be lost.

tests.name: resume returns receiver
tests.input: const {PassThrough}=require('node:stream'); const r=new PassThrough(); r.pause(); console.log(r.resume()===r);

tests.name: resume can discard
tests.expected_behavior: stream is fully consumed even though no data listener processed x
